content.text: Marcus JosephIf it can't be Sinners, let it be Hamnet.255134Alan GammillLong shot…but del Toro’s Frankenstein is a masterpiece523Jake ClarkIt has to be Hamnet for me. I feel like the people who just see this film as a great performance by Jessie Buckley must not have children. It was one of the strongest emotional responses I have ever had to a movie. I could not help but see my child while watching it and I connected with Paul Mescal and Jessie Buckley and the way they portrayed the grief. 166Justin JacksonOne Battle is overrated IMO. Bugonia and Marty Supreme were both surprisingly great movies. If Sinners doesn’t win, I’ll be satisfied with one of those two130Sara WestonI loved all that I’ve seen here but Bugonia, to me was the most unique and by far the most fun watch. Loved it. I’ve never seen anything like it. Felt inventive and funny and dark and just… not a boring bit in it.213Amanda L HinesFrankenstein should be at the top. I was really impressed by it.
